summary: Checked the client-side gate behind linearizable reads: SyncRead resolves a ReadIndex, waits on the request state, and only then queries the local state machine, and the state is completed by the applied-index pass only when its batch carries a ready-to-read index the applied index has reached — a batch with index zero is skipped, so confirmation alone cannot complete it. Recorded the gate as knowledge and an explained negative for the stale-read suspicion, with bounds (staleness bounded, freshness not; in-memory path only). No execution requested.
